skill.name: xdrop
skill.description: Upload and download encrypted file transfers through an Xdrop server using bundled Bun command-line scripts.
skill.summary: Manage encrypted Xdrop upload and download workflows from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
skill.author: xixu-me

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks or JavaScript template literals, and I found no prompt injection attempt. The remaining confirmed risks are the intended Xdrop network transfers and local file writes performed during downloads.

remediation.issue: Network transfers go to user-provided Xdrop endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Keep server selection explicit, prefer HTTPS endpoints, and warn users before uploading sensitive files.

remediation.issue: Downloads write decrypted remote content to local paths.
remediation.suggestion: Preserve path sanitization and consider refusing to overwrite existing files unless the user confirms.

content.value_statement: Manual Xdrop transfers can be slow when links, keys, and output paths must be handled carefully. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the bundled upload and download scripts.
actual_capabilities: Uploads files or directories to an Xdrop server with a generated share link.
Downloads a full Xdrop share link and decrypts files locally.
Supports quiet and JSON output modes for automation workflows.
Accepts custom server and API URLs for self-hosted Xdrop deployments.
Preserves relative paths while sanitizing downloaded manifest paths.
Lets users set expiry, display name, output directory, and upload concurrency.
limitations: Requires Bun and local filesystem access on the machine running the scripts.
Requires network access to the selected Xdrop server and generated file URLs.
Cannot decrypt downloads when the share link fragment key is missing.
Does not independently verify that a user-selected server is trustworthy.

use_cases.title: Share Build Artifacts
use_cases.description: Upload release files or build outputs to an Xdrop server and return a share link.

use_cases.title: Fetch Received Transfers
use_cases.description: Download a complete Xdrop link, decrypt the files locally, and save them to a chosen folder.

use_cases.title: Automate Transfer Scripts
use_cases.description: Use quiet or JSON output for shell workflows that need stable script output.

prompt_templates.title: Upload One File
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload this file to my Xdrop server and give me the share link: <file path> using <server URL>.

prompt_templates.title: Download a Share Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Download and decrypt this full Xdrop share link into <output folder>: <share URL with fragment key>.

prompt_templates.title: Create Automation Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload <paths> to <server URL> with quiet JSON output and an expiry of <seconds> seconds.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Custom API Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Xdrop API endpoint <api URL> to transfer <paths>, set the display name to <name>, and limit concurrency to <n>.

output_examples.input: Upload a local archive to an Xdrop server.
output_examples.output: Returns a share link that includes the transfer identifier and decryption key fragment.

output_examples.input: Download a full Xdrop link into a downloads folder.
output_examples.output: Creates the output folder, saves decrypted files, and reports the saved paths.

output_examples.input: Run an upload in quiet structured mode.
output_examples.output: Provides machine-readable transfer details without progress text in standard output.

best_practices: Confirm the target Xdrop server before uploading files.
Keep the full share link fragment intact for downloads.
Use quiet or structured output when another process consumes results.
anti_patterns: Do not upload sensitive files to an untrusted or unexpected server.
Do not remove the fragment key from a share link before downloading.
Do not bypass the bundled path sanitization with manual file writes.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It runs bundled Bun scripts for Xdrop upload and download workflows.

faq.question: Does it encrypt files?
faq.answer: The upload script encrypts file chunks and the manifest before finalizing the transfer.

faq.question: Can it download without the key fragment?
faq.answer: No. The full link must include the fragment key because the downloader needs it for decryption.

faq.question: Can I use a self-hosted Xdrop server?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts accept custom server and API URL options.

faq.question: Does it write files locally?
faq.answer: Yes. Downloads are decrypted and written under the selected output directory.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is documented for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
